reads.description: The distinct local names the receiver and arguments read. Local names are keyed: a name its function declares once is the bare name; a name declared more than once in one function (shadowing, or the same name in sibling blocks or loops) is `name@line` (1-based line of the declared identifier, `name@line:col` when two share a line). The key is the same everywhere it appears in that function (binds, reads, argReads, derives keys and values, params). Display strips the `@…` suffix.

argReads.description: The local names each positional argument reads, one list per argument, keyed as reads. Emitted only when an argument reads a local; the stage model maps a helper parameter at position i to argReads[i].

argSpread.description: Index of the first spread argument; parameters from that position on take the spread argument reads.
